title: Avo-6-Part-3
description: Avionics Part 3 exam covering aircraft data buses, OSI and TCP/IP models, fiber optics, ACARS, digital modulation, network topologies, and data communication.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct
options: A. most avionics buses are serial
questions.explanation: most avionics buses are serial is the correct answer.

questions.question: At a wavelength of 850 nm, what is the equivalent frequency of the source?
questions.explanation: 357 THz is the correct answer.

questions.question: Who developed a model for the connection of open systems known as the Open Systems Interconnection Reference Model?
questions.explanation: ISO is the correct answer.

questions.question: An optic transmitter consists of:
options: A. Interface circuit, source driver and optical source
questions.explanation: Interface circuit, source driver and optical source is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which one is not true about Source Identifier (SDI)?
options: B. It can be predefined rate at which is received
questions.explanation: It can be predefined rate at which is received is the correct answer.

questions.question: In aircraft, serial data transfer is achieved by:
questions.explanation: Time division multiplexing is the correct answer.

questions.question: Digital modulation using phase shifting without reference is:
questions.explanation: Differential phase shift keying (DPSK) is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the ability of numerical aperture?
options: B. Interface circuit, source driver and optical source
questions.explanation: light collection is the correct answer.

questions.question: Data communication improves safety features by:
options: A. reducing human error due to voice communication
C. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: reducing human error due to voice communication is the correct answer.

questions.question: The 4th layer in the OSI model is:
questions.explanation: Transport is the correct answer.

questions.question: Laser diode undergoes light amplification by:
questions.explanation: Stimulated emission is the correct answer.

questions.question: ARINC 429 is a:
options: B. single source multiple sink system
questions.explanation: single source multiple sink system is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which transmission medium is unguided?
options: B. most avionics buses are serial
questions.explanation: wireless is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which topology is a circle enclosed loop formed?
questions.explanation: Ring topology is the correct answer.

questions.question: A system in which computers are interconnected and geographically spread within a building is:
options: C. most avionics buses are serial
questions.explanation: LAN is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which aircraft data bus specification is used on general aviation aircraft?
options: B. It has a word length of 32 bits
questions.explanation: ASCB is the correct answer.

questions.question: In ISO architecture, dialogue control is the responsibility of the:
questions.explanation: session layer is the correct answer.

questions.question: Selection of one wavelength and leaving the other is:
questions.explanation: fiber optics filters is the correct answer.

questions.question: Sending 1 bit of data simultaneously to different channels within the same cable is:
options: B. single source multiple sink system
questions.explanation: parallel is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the maximum bit rate supported by ARINC 629?
questions.explanation: 2 Mbps is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the word length of ARINC 629?
questions.explanation: 16 bits is the correct answer.

questions.question: ARINC 629 is a:
questions.explanation: Multi transmitter data bus is the correct answer.

questions.question: What are the operating wavelengths of fiber optics?
options: A. It can be predefined rate at which is received
questions.explanation: 850, 1300, 1550 nm is the correct answer.

questions.question: CSDB is a unidirectional bus that permits connection to terminals at:
questions.explanation: 12.5 kbps / 50 kbps is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which network is widely used in aircraft?
options: A. Interface circuit, source driver and optical source
questions.explanation: LAN is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which device is used to detect by the photoelectric effect?
questions.explanation: photodiode is the correct answer.

questions.question: A multimode step-index fiber has a large core diameter range of:
options: C. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: 100 to 300 µm is the correct answer.

questions.question: The 2nd layer on TCP/IP is:
questions.explanation: Data link is the correct answer.

questions.question: How many layers does TCP/IP have?
questions.explanation: 5 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which device is used to combine and split optical signals between fibers?
options: A. It has a word length of 32 bits
questions.explanation: optical coupler is the correct answer.

questions.question: CSMA/CA is used as media access in which ARINC standard?
questions.explanation: ARINC 629 is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the process of converting digital data into digital signals called?
questions.explanation: Line encoding is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the number of receivers/sinks in ARINC 629?
questions.explanation: 120 is the correct answer.

questions.question: How many fields does a typical ACARS data format contain?
options: A. Interface circuit, source driver and optical source
questions.explanation: 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is commonly used as an optical detector?
questions.explanation: APD is the correct answer.

questions.question: What do we call a distributed network configuration in which all data/information pass through a central computer/hub?
questions.explanation: bus network is the correct answer.

questions.question: The validity of an ARINC 429 data word is checked by using:
questions.explanation: parity bit is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which system is used for air-ground digital data link communication and also between air carrier and aircraft?
questions.explanation: ACARS is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which standard is ACARS currently defined?
options: A. It can be predefined rate at which is received
questions.explanation: ARINC 724B is the correct answer.

questions.question: The two types of ACARS communication method are:
options: A. most avionics buses are serial
questions.explanation: Demand and polled is the correct answer.

questions.question: Communication started in the cockpit is:
questions.explanation: Demand is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which OSI layer handles data formatting, compression, and acts as a translator for the network?
questions.explanation: presentation layer is the correct answer.

questions.question: What section represents the type of information contained within the 32-bit word of ARINC 429?
options: B. reducing human error due to voice communication
questions.explanation: Label is the correct answer.

questions.question: One of the major differences between single-mode and multimode fiber optic is:
questions.explanation: core diameter is the correct answer.

questions.question: The process of superimposing a low-frequency signal with a high-frequency carrier is called:
questions.explanation: Modulation is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is used for joining optical fibers?
options: C. Reduction in the size and weight of cabling
questions.explanation: Optical splices is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which is used to allow reconfiguration, typically at a termination point?
questions.explanation: Connector is the correct answer.

questions.question: A topology connection in a loop where each node has 2 neighbors is:
questions.explanation: ring topology is the correct answer.

questions.question: The most common protocol in the network layer is:
questions.explanation: IP is the correct answer.

questions.question: Loss occurs due to diffraction of light when it strikes irregularities of cable during manufacturing. This is called:
options: C. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: absorption loss is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which OSI layer determines the interface of the system with the user?
questions.explanation: application layer is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the loss in signal power called as light travels down the fiber?
questions.explanation: Attenuation is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the primary visual instrument that the flight crew uses to access the ACARS system?
questions.explanation: The CDU is the correct answer.

questions.question: In what type of transmission mode is communication unidirectional?
options: C. Step index single mode fiber
questions.explanation: Simplex is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the dielectric material surrounding the core called?
questions.explanation: Cladding is the correct answer.

questions.question: In the airborne ACARS system, which component manages incoming and outgoing messages?
questions.explanation: Management unit is the correct answer.

questions.question: The way devices are interconnected in a network is called:
questions.explanation: Network topology is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about ARINC 429?
options: C. It has a word length of 32 bits
questions.explanation: It has a word length of 32 bits is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which layer supports user applications like HTTP, SMTP, OSAM and email?
questions.explanation: application layer is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which data bus uses optical fiber?
questions.explanation: AFDX (664) is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the sequence of operations in which pulse code modulation is done?
questions.explanation: Sampling, Quantization, encoding is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which communication medium does ACARS use?
questions.explanation: VHF (118 MHz - 137 MHz) is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which topology are the nodes connected to a single cable?
questions.explanation: Bus is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which fiber is preferable for long-distance communication?
options: C. Step index single mode fiber
questions.explanation: Step index single mode fiber is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which transmission line has an inner copper conductor and outer conductor separated by an insulator?
questions.explanation: Coaxial cable is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which OSI model layer implements hardware equipment?
questions.explanation: physical layer is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is a typical receiver function for an optical fiber communication system?
questions.explanation: optical to electrical conversion is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the maximum bit rate supported by the ARINC 664/AFDX data bus?
options: A. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: 100 Mbps is the correct answer.

questions.question: What do we call a distributed network configuration in which all data/information pass through a central computer/hub?
questions.explanation: Star network is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which type of digital modulation technique is a combination of ASK and PSK?
questions.explanation: QAM is the correct answer.

questions.question: What does the data link layer divide the data units received from the network layer into?
questions.explanation: Frames is the correct answer.

questions.question: What do protocols (sets of rules) govern?
questions.explanation: Communication is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which type of serial transmission are frames sent independently with start/stop flags?
options: C. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: Asynchronous is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a network, participating computers are referred to as:
options: C. Interface circuit, source driver and optical source
questions.explanation: Nodes is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which OSI layer performs data sequencing, where a long message is broken into smaller packets or fixed-size units for error-free transmission?
options: B. Reduction in the size and weight of cabling
questions.explanation: Transport layer is the correct answer.

questions.question: Data routing is under which OSI model layer?
questions.explanation: Network is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the maximum data bit rate supported by the ARINC 429 data bus?
questions.explanation: 100 Kbps is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which topology has the highest reliability?
questions.explanation: Mesh topology is the correct answer.

questions.question: A multimode step-index fiber has a large core diameter range of:
questions.explanation: 100 to 300 µm is the correct answer.

questions.question: How is error detection and correction done?
questions.explanation: By adding redundancy bits is the correct answer.

questions.question: A system that governs message formats and rules for exchanging messages between communicating devices in a data communication network is called:
options: B. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: Communication protocol is the correct answer.

questions.question: A bus that is self-clocking is referred to as:
questions.explanation: Asynchronous is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following can be considered a major problem in fiber optic communication?
questions.explanation: Its unidirectional is the correct answer.

questions.question: What property does data transmission in fiber optic cable exploit?
questions.explanation: Total internal reflection is the correct answer.

questions.question: Why is serial transmission preferred for most data transmission?
options: B. Reduction in the size and weight of cabling
questions.explanation: Reduction in the size and weight of cabling is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which mode does the ACARS system operate only when interrogated from the ground station?
questions.explanation: polled is the correct answer.

questions.question: How many maximum receivers/sinks can be connected on a single ARINC 429 data bus?
questions.explanation: 20 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which process is adopted for laser beam formation as it undergoes light amplification?
options: C. Reduction in the size and weight of cabling
questions.explanation: Stimulated emission is the correct answer.

questions.question: A data communication network that covers a relatively large geographic area and often uses transmission facilities provided by common carriers is a:
questions.explanation: WAN is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which layer oversees delivery of a data unit between two systems on different networks?
options: B. Interface circuit, source driver and optical source
questions.explanation: Network is the correct answer.

questions.question: What process converts analog information into a binary sequence of 1s and 0s?
options: A. reducing human error due to voice communication
C. Step index single mode fiber
questions.explanation: PCM (pulse code modulation) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is a typical receiver function in an optical fiber communication system?
options: B. optical signal to output electrical signal conversion
questions.explanation: optical signal to output electrical signal conversion is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which digital modulation technique does the frequency of the carrier vary according to discrete digital signals?
questions.explanation: FSK is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which protocol function finds the most efficient route between source and destination before sending the data?
questions.explanation: Data routing is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which mode does the ACARS system operate only when interrogated from the ground station?
questions.explanation: polled mode is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which mode does the ACARS system operate when the flight crew can initialize communication?
questions.explanation: Demand mode is the correct answer.

questions.question: What network technology connects machines and people within a site in a small area?
questions.explanation: LAN is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which aircraft data bus standard is primarily designed for use in military aircraft?
questions.explanation: MIL-STD-1553B is the correct answer.

questions.question: What do we call a distributed network configuration in which all data/information pass through a central computer/hub?
questions.explanation: Star network is the correct answer.

questions.question: How is error detection and correction done?
options: B. single source multiple sink system
questions.explanation: By adding redundancy bits is the correct answer.
